name: organic-garden
vibe: A warm cream garden that keeps growing behind the film — drifting petals and leaves, soft blooms of colour and two rolling hills, all flowing continuously across every cut so the scenes read as one place rather than a slide deck. Soft serif display over friendly geometric body copy, rounded shadowed device frames, and a calm camera that drifts, swings and pushes through each cut with no hard wipe. Brand colour regrows the whole garden — petals, hills, blooms, chips and the ground itself. Portrait-native 9:16. Best for warm, human, craft and wellbeing brands.
